newsitem.title: JAPAN: Moody's assigns Aaa to Chubu Electric 3.5% bonds.
newsitem.headline: Moody's assigns Aaa to Chubu Electric 3.5% bonds.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said on Tuesday it had assigned its Aaa rating to Chubu Electric Power Co Inc's 30 billion yen worth of 3.5 percent straight bonds due 2017.
The rating reflects Chubu's important role in the Japanese economy and the favourable business environment the utility operates under, the rating agency said.

Chubu is Japan's third largest electric power utility and has a virtual monopoly in serving the the Chubu region, central Japan, one of the fastest growing areas in Japan, Moody's said in a statement.
It is highly likely the company will receive strong regulatory and governmental support if needed, Moody's said.
